agent_notes: NIRF Dental and Medical 2025 directory pages directly list Santosh University in Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh; the Overall source was also checked but no matching row was observed.

The managed proxy returned the exact curl error "self signed certificate in certificate chain" for expected public HTTPS hosts; public GET requests then used curl --insecure only after confirming the expected nirfindia.org and santosh.ac.in hostnames.

The official site exposes 54 current degree/diploma programme pages through its admissions, medical-programs and dental-programs catalogues, plus an active Fellowship in Stem Cell & Regenerative Medicine page.
The official certificate route https://www.santosh.ac.in/certificate returns a 301 redirect to /university and does not expose a current certificate programme.

The Ph.D. page exposes a current September 2026 admissions notice, and the medical/dental college pages mention Ph.D. offerings, but no discipline-specific Ph.D. catalogue entries are exposed on the official website; the Ph.D. entry is therefore a programme-family record with no career mapping and this result requires manual review.
The PG Diploma in Forensic Medicine page contains a copy-pasted duration sentence naming PG Diploma in Public Health; duration was left null for that course rather than inferring it.
Career mappings were read from assets/data/career_path.db with sqlite read-only access; nearest-parent and closest-specialization relations are labelled where no exact node exists.
